correctness.rationale: For each incidence-count vector y, the center EFX criterion is sum(y)+min(y)≥q−1; leaf EFX requires y_i≤floor(q/2) unless all other center receipts vanish, in which case a single exceptional q=3 configuration family contributes exactly 3b labeled orientations. These equivalences produce Equation (1), and for b≥q−1, low total forces a zero component, proving Equation (2). Fixed-q coefficient deficits are polynomial of degree ≤q−2; binomial half-sums establish parity in Equation (3). Independently enumerating all goods deletions over 13 small (b,q) pairs yielded agreement; no finite check was misused as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Multistar existence is known, but the fraction of complete nonwasteful assignments satisfying the standard all-goods EFX criterion is a mathematically motivated independent invariant of fairness fragility. The precise full two-parameter enumerator and parity-dependent asymptotic exponent quantify a natural random-allocation baseline and identify a genuine exceptional multiplicity. This does not claim broad graph counting complexity or downstream application.
